name: Field Play
tagline: A plane of arrows. Pour particles with a finger and watch them flow.
description:
The last field, camera, and knobs are saved with the app. Press Play together, then Invite in the bar above the app, and a friend lands on the same recipe.

Every point on the plane has a little arrow. Particles follow those arrows: spirals, cogs, rain, a black hole. Tap a named field to try one. Tap the picture to pour more particles. Drag to pan, pinch or scroll to zoom. Change a number in the recipe, press Apply, and the flow becomes yours.

On a phone the recipe sheet starts closed so the field fills the screen. Recipe opens the program and the knobs.

An unofficial port of Field Play by anvaka.
